title: Smart-pool-array protocol for a yeast two-hybrid array
protocol: Completely thaw frozen 96-well stock plates and vortex gently to resuspend the cells.
Pipette 5 μL from the 96-well frozen stock of yeast into each well of a 96 deep well plate containing 300 μL YEPD plus 20 mg/L adenine.
Vortex the mixture gently to resuspend the yeast.
Incubate at 30°C for 24-48 hours until all wells are uniformly grown.
Shake plates approximately every 12 hours during incubation.
Seal plates with film or incubate in containers or plastic bags with a moist paper towel to reduce evaporation.
Pool plates according to the specified configuration in the protocol, creating pools of 32 strains per well.
Aliquot each plate into 6 plates after replication and growth to saturation.
Aliquot contents of each well in a freshly grown plate into 6 separate plates.
Aspirate at least 80 μL from the source plate and dispense 10 μL to each destination plate.
Repeat step for each source plate (Plates 2-64).
Change destination plates according to specified distribution pattern.
Ensure tips do not touch sides of wells during aspiration or dispensing.
Final volume in each well of destination plates should be 320 μL.
Aliquot contents of SPA_6 plates into 96 well plates with a final volume of 5% DMSO.
Freeze the 96 well plates containing culture at -80°C.
Prepare at least three copies of these frozen plates.
Thaw SPA_6 plates from the freezer.
Pin four staggered 96-well plates onto each 384-spot plate using an HDRT equipped with 96 stainless steel pins.
Sterilize pins before use, dipping them in bleach, water, and ethanol reservoirs.
Incubate the omni trays for 6-12 hours at room temperature.
Screen the Smart Pool Array by mating a bait strain with SPA_6 prey strains.
Grow a bait strain to saturation in 50 mL of YEPD.
Centrifuge and resuspend the culture to 20 mL in fresh YEPD.
Pour the concentrated bait strain into an empty and sterile omnitray.
Pin from the bait reservoir using a 384 pin HDR tool.
Allow yeast to mate and grow by incubating at room temperature for 2 days.
Select colony material from YEPD plate using HDR tool after pre-wetting pins in sterile water reservoir.
Transfer selected colonies to \(-Leu\)-Trp omni tray plates multiple times to ensure sufficient transfer of material.
Incubate diploids at 30°C for 3 days to allow growth.
Pin cells from diploid plates to two-hybrid selective plates using HDR tool.
Use appropriate selective plates based on reporter used, for HIS3 reporter use \(-His\)-Leu-Trp plates supplemented with 3-aminotriazole.
Incubate the plates for 7-10 days until positive colonies are observed.
The pattern of growth on the plates can be used to deconvolute the prey strain identity using provided code.
Divide 384 spot omni tray plates into quadrants corresponding to four 96 well plates.
Position A1 contains four spots, with only two growing if a positive bait-prey diploid is present.
Identify the prey position based on growth patterns and plate pair information.
